headline: Pal Sphere unlock levels in Palworld
title: Pal Sphere Unlock Levels | Mega, Giga, Hyper, Ultra | Palworld Guide
video_script: Which Pal Sphere can you make at your level in Palworld one point zero? The basic Pal Sphere unlocks at level two. Mega Sphere comes at level fourteen. Giga Sphere at level twenty. Hyper Sphere at level twenty seven. Ultra Sphere at level thirty five. And the Legendary Sphere unlocks at level forty four. Save the strongest ones for Alphas and big targets, and weaken the Pal first. Which sphere do you use most? Comment below!
description: Palworld 1.0 Pal Sphere unlock levels: Pal 2, Mega 14, Giga 20, Hyper 27, Ultra 35, Legendary 44.
